GreetingSection.name: Serdar Gökhan
GreetingSection.title: Frontend Developer
GreetingSection.paragraph-one: I'm a frontend developer and mechatronics engineer based in İstanbul. I build websites that look sharp, load fast, and feel right on every browser and device.
GreetingSection.paragraph-two: Scroll down and you'll see where I've worked and what I've been up to. Right now I'm at <link>Borusan Otomotiv</link>, building sites that are intuitive, easy to use, and genuinely useful to our customers.

AboutSection.title: About Me
AboutSection.paragraph-one: I'm Serdar Gökhan, a mechatronics engineer who graduated from Marmara University. I live in İstanbul, started coding while I was still in university, and in June 2021 I set out to build for the web.
AboutSection.paragraph-two: I started with the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — and made sure I really understood them. That foundation helped me pick up React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript quickly.
AboutSection.paragraph-three: Along the way I've built a lot of projects, and I want to keep sharpening my skills and getting better at what I do. The web never stands still, and that's exactly what I love about it.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.seo-description: How this portfolio handles your data.
Privacy.intro: This is a personal portfolio. There are no accounts, no contact forms, and no ads, so there's very little to say here.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: I use Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights to see which pages are visited and how quickly they load. Both are cookieless, don't fingerprint visitors, and don't track you across other sites.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.body: Vercel serves the site and processes standard server logs, like IP address and user agent, to keep it secure and reliable.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you email me, your message stays in my inbox for as long as it takes me to reply. I don't add you to any list, and I don't share your address.
